description: This file defines a PHP class 'DataEncryptor' responsible for encrypting and decrypting data using AES-256-GCM. It includes methods for key derivation, encryption, and decryption, and handles cryptographic operations with OpenSSL.

classes.name: DataEncryptor
classes.description: A class providing methods for encrypting and decrypting data securely using AES-256-GCM, with key derivation from a password.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts plaintext with a password, returning an array containing the IV, authentication tag, and ciphertext.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts ciphertext using IV, password, and tag, returning the original plaintext or false if decryption fails.

methods.name: deriveKey
methods.description: Generates a fixed-length cryptographic key from a password using SHA-256 hash.
